critical_code_review_comments: App.js: long if/else chain of routeId-to-component (15+ branches). Consider extracting a routeId→component map in /lib/routes.js to remove the imperative router resolver — improves maintainability as more pages are added.

ProgramTemplate.jsx is the universal template — recommend snapshotting once locally to confirm all 4 pricing seasons and all 4 details accordion tabs render uniformly across both variants (heuristic counts confirm structure, no targeted testids on those subsections).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (14/14 pages render; 0 console errors; navigation, i18n, sticky-nav all pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 new pages verified rendering, navigation, hub-card click routing, language switcher preserving page across ES/EN/FR, sticky-nav anchor scroll, and program-template day counts (4n5d→5 days, 5n6d→6 days, 6n7d→7 days for both 'da' and 'ad' variants).
